newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-LITHUANIAN AIRLINES, AIR LITHUANIA TO MERGE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-LITHUANIAN AIRLINES, AIR LITHUANIA TO MERGE.

text.p: Lithuanian Airlines (LAL) and smaller carrier Air Lithuania will join forces in a merger or alliance this year and LAL will remain the only national carrier, the transport ministry said on Friday.
"Those companies are going to be merged into one," Transport Minister Algis Zvaliauskas told a news conference.
Deputy transportation minister Algirdas Shakalys said the union could in practice take the form of a joining, merger, full merger or an alliance but that it would take place this year.
LAL and Air Lithuania are two of the 13 major state-owned enterprises scheduled for privatisation by open international tender in the next two years.

"We are planning that before privatisation the two will be joined into one company...but we don't know what the new company will be called," said Vaclovas Narbutas, director of the transportation ministry's information department.
Narbutas said that the merger of the two companies would mean there would be one privatisation process for the two.
